prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural

Asset: Door states and visible interior

Composition: 16:9 aspect ratio.

Create a precisely aligned three-panel reference sheet of the SAME target train doorway: fully open, halfway closed, fully closed. Each panel has the same viewpoint, frame, width, threshold, lights, and exterior markings. Open doors reveal warm-neutral lighting, a restrained gray floor, simple handrails, and a small seating section. The doors translate sideways into the body rather than folding. No person trapped in the doorway, no Riley, no new passenger identity. This is a reference sheet, not a starting frame.

Train continuity: Original near-future commuter train compatible with the station inspiration: dark graphite streamlined body, cyan accent strip and restrained magenta reflections, large tinted windows, paired sliding doors with a central vertical seam, warm-neutral interior lighting. Provisional identifier: carriage 07 with a simple cyan double-line mark beside the target doorway. Preserve body proportions, door spacing, windows, and markings once a reference is selected.

Rendering: Photorealistic premium live-action commercial look, physically plausible materials, believable anatomy and construction, controlled contrast, natural detail. No illustration, game screenshot, plastic skin, excessive bloom, or baked-in cinematic motion blur. Reference assets should be sharp enough to inspect. No decorative watermarks; the official contest watermark will be added during final editing.

Reference handling: Use the supplied images in the listed order and for their specified roles. Preserve selected designs; do not invent a new identity or silently replace a missing dependency.

Input images in order: train-01.
review: Visually inspected; retained as test reference. Not user-approved final.
